name: pablo-one-poc-indexer
description: Ingest scripts (local) + the indexer Lambda that embeds data/*.json into the S3 Vectors index.

scripts.ingest:all: tsx crawl.ts && tsx github.ts && tsx code.ts && tsx docs.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none && mkdir -p dist/data && cp data/*.json dist/data/
